def _superseded_pin_scope(c,question,programme,question_db_id,pin):
    """Resume an existing immutable session, never authorize new old-version use."""
    if not pin:return None
    verified=integration_v1.answer_pin({'ph_question_pins_json':integration_v1.canonical_json({str(question_db_id):pin})},question_db_id)
    if any(verified.get(k)!=question.get(field) for k,field in (
       ('question_id','ph_question_id'),('question_version_id','ph_question_version_id'),
       ('question_checksum_sha256','ph_question_checksum_sha256'))):return None
    row=c.execute("""SELECT r.programme_id,r.subject_id,r.chapter_id,v.curriculum_json
      FROM integration_ph_content_releases r
      JOIN integration_ph_release_question_membership m
        ON m.release_id=r.release_id AND m.release_version=r.release_version
      JOIN integration_ph_question_version_store v
        ON v.question_id=m.question_id AND v.question_version_id=m.question_version_id
      JOIN questions current ON current.id=v.local_question_db_id
      WHERE r.release_id=? AND r.release_version=? AND r.package_checksum_sha256=?
        AND r.local_status='SUPERSEDED'
        AND v.question_id=? AND v.question_version_id=? AND v.question_checksum_sha256=?
        AND current.id=? AND current.active=1 AND current.status='Approved'
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration_ph_product_activation_authorizations a
          WHERE a.release_id=r.release_id AND a.release_version=r.release_version
            AND a.package_checksum_sha256=r.package_checksum_sha256 AND a.activation_status IN ('AUTHORIZED','ACTIVATED'))
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e e
          WHERE e.release_id=m.release_id AND e.release_version=m.release_version
            AND e.question_id=m.question_id AND e.question_version_id=m.question_version_id)""",
      (verified['release_id'],verified['release_version'],verified['release_checksum_sha256'],
       verified['question_id'],verified['question_version_id'],verified['question_checksum_sha256'],question_db_id)).fetchone()
    if not row or question_contracts.programme_for_release(row['programme_id'],row['curriculum_json'])!=canonical_programme(programme):
        return None
    return {'programme':canonical_programme(programme),'subject':str(row['subject_id']).replace('_',' ').title(),
            'chapter_id':row['chapter_id']}

def _preserve_other_active_memberships(c,question_ids):
    """A release-level stop must not erase another exact authorized placement.

    Call only for rows that were active before this operation. A prior global
    academic question withdrawal stays inactive and is never revived here.
    """
    for qdb in question_ids:
        row=c.execute("""SELECT r.release_id,r.release_version,r.package_checksum_sha256
          FROM questions q JOIN integration_ph_question_version_store v
            ON v.question_id=q.ph_question_id AND v.question_version_id=q.ph_question_version_id
              AND v.question_checksum_sha256=q.ph_question_checksum_sha256 AND v.local_question_db_id=q.id
          JOIN integration_ph_release_question_membership m
            ON m.question_id=v.question_id AND m.question_version_id=v.question_version_id
          JOIN integration_ph_content_releases r
            ON r.release_id=m.release_id AND r.release_version=m.release_version
          WHERE q.id=? AND r.local_status='ACTIVE'
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration_ph_product_activation_authorizations a
              WHERE a.release_id=r.release_id AND a.release_version=r.release_version
                AND a.package_checksum_sha256=r.package_checksum_sha256
                AND a.activation_status IN ('AUTHORIZED','ACTIVATED'))
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ph_bridge_staged_withdrawal_exclusions_v6611e e
              WHERE e.release_id=m.release_id AND e.release_version=m.release_version
                AND e.question_id=m.question_id AND e.question_version_id=m.question_version_id)
          ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1""",(qdb,)).fetchone()
        if row:
            c.execute("""UPDATE questions SET active=1,status='Approved',ph_release_id=?,
                         ph_release_version=?,ph_release_checksum_sha256=? WHERE id=?""",
                      (row['release_id'],row['release_version'],row['package_checksum_sha256'],qdb))
